purpose: Compare one untouched Gemini Flash Lite reference recreation with non-destructive finishing and four motion-tool treatments.

source.preservation: Untouched copy of the Flash Lite reference recreation; never overwritten.

treatments.intent: A restrained still-image polish, preserving composition and subjects.
Four-second cinematic push-in and drift from the finished still.
Four-second layered parallax, controlled light sweep, and surface texture treatment.
Four-second browser-rendered push-in with a restrained amber sweep and animated patterned overlay.

rule: Every render is a sibling output. Source files and prior outputs remain intact.
